summary: D1-PR-003 and D1-PR-004 are resolved, but the Proposal still makes full-test runnable whenever deliveryFullTestStatus is not passed. That includes failed, whereas frozen Full Test recovery requires an owner corrective/cancel decision and preserves failed until a corrective Change resets it.

blockingFindings.title: full-test precondition allows direct retry after a failed Full Test
blockingFindings.evidence: The Proposal defines full-test as allowed when all required Changes are completed/checkpointed, authorization exists, and deliveryFullTestStatus != passed. Thus failed satisfies the precondition. Frozen verification-model.md requires fullTestStatus to remain failed and Policy to return an owner decision boundary or blocked diagnosis; the owner may authorize a corrective Change or cancel, and only the corrective Change resets the status to not-ready before another Full Test cycle.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Limit full-test eligibility to the pre-execution states defined by the frozen Full Test lifecycle (awaiting-user-decision or explicitly authorized, as appropriate to the action boundary); failed must return full-test-failed owner-decision/blocked behavior, never action full-test. Add table-driven coverage for failed preserving the status and for the corrective-Change reset path. Update Design, Spec, Tasks, and the next/diagnose rules consistently.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Archive now requires task completion and fails closed with tasks-facts-unavailable while the snapshot cannot provide that fact.
delivery-finalize now requires deliveryFullTestStatus=passed and does not accept Change Verification not-applicable.
